# dhi Provider

The DHI provider manages Docker Hardened Images customizations, mirrors, and catalog lookups via the Docker Scout GraphQL API.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_url` (String) Override the DHI API URL. Can also be set with the `DHI_API_URL` environment variable.
- `docker_hub_password` (String, Sensitive) Docker Hub password or personal access token. Can also be set with the `DOCKER_PASSWORD` environment variable.
- `docker_hub_username` (String) Docker Hub username for token exchange. Can also be set with the `DOCKER_USERNAME` environment variable.
- `organization` (String) Docker organization namespace. Can also be set with the `DHI_ORG` environment variable.
